reason: Authored the complete argument: on an affine chart B is a faithful A[b]-module finitely generated over A, so the finite-module integrality criterion makes every b integral; quotients of B stay integral, and lying-over (AC) identifies the image of V(J) with V(ker(A->B/J)), giving closedness on charts; closedness glues over affine covers and is stable under the finite base change that AC supplies. Repaired deps: dropped scaffold's thm-going-up (unused; lying-over alone suffices), added def-affine-scheme-spectrum and lem-zariski-closed-set-axioms for the closed-subset identification and def-integral-element-and-algebraic-integer for integrality of quotients.
